intro_zh: 地图上的表达分两类：描述位置（be located in、be situated in、to the north of、adjacent to、next to）和描述变化（be replaced by、be converted into、expand、be demolished、remain unchanged）。静态位置用一般现在时，变化用过去时或现在完成时；同一句里不要混用两种视角。
intro_en: Where places are on a map, and how places change over time.

expressions.head: be located in
expressions.pattern: X is located in + city / country / region

examples.en: Shanghai is located in eastern China and has 1,420 thousand monthly readers.
examples.zh: 上海位于中国东部，每月有 1,420 千名读者。

examples.en: Shanghai is located on the coast, and its lane to Los Angeles carries 412 thousand TEU a year.
examples.zh: 上海位于沿海，它到洛杉矶的航线每年运输 412 千标准箱。

expressions.contrast_zh: be located in 最中性，城市、国家、区域都能用；be situated in 更正式，多用于建筑或地块；be based in 指公司、团队常驻哪里，不是地理位置。

expressions.head: be situated in
expressions.pattern: X is situated in / on + place
collocations: is situated in the city center

examples.en: Spain is situated in southwestern Europe and drew 85 million arrivals.
examples.zh: 西班牙位于欧洲西南部，入境游客达 8,500 万人次。

expressions.contrast_zh: 比 be located in 正式，介绍酒店、校园、建筑位置时常用；日常口语里 located 更常见，situated 用在口语里会显得刻意。

expressions.head: to the north of
expressions.meaning_zh: 在……以北（范围之外的方位）
expressions.pattern: A is (to the) north of B
collocations: to the north of the city

examples.en: Washington, to the north of Oregon, has a remote-work rate of 31, compared with 43 in Oregon.
examples.zh: 华盛顿州位于俄勒冈州以北，远程办公比例为 31，俄勒冈州为 43。

expressions.contrast_zh: to the north of 表示在某个地区范围之外的北边；in the north of 表示在地区内部的北部。两者不能互换，地图题里常考这个区别。

expressions.head: adjacent to

examples.en: France is adjacent to Germany: France drew 100 million arrivals and Germany 40 million.
examples.zh: 法国与德国相邻：法国入境游客 1 亿人次，德国 4,000 万人次。

expressions.contrast_zh: adjacent to 最正式，指紧挨着、共用边界；next to 更口语，距离也更宽松，隔一条街也能说 next to。地图上强调地理接壤用 adjacent to。

expressions.head: next to
expressions.pattern: X is next to + place / next to each other

examples.en: The pickup shelf is next to the checkout, so orders are easy to grab on the way out.
examples.zh: 取货架就在收银台旁边，出门时顺手就能拿。

expressions.contrast_zh: 口语里最自然；near 只表示附近，距离可能很远，不能当成 next to 用。正式写作里把 next to 换成 adjacent to。

expressions.head: be replaced by
expressions.meaning_zh: 被……取代（原来的人或物不在了）
expressions.pattern: X was replaced by Y / X has been replaced by Y

examples.en: The old ticket counter was replaced by self-service kiosks last year.
examples.zh: 旧的售票柜台去年被自助机取代了。

expressions.contrast_zh: be replaced by 是被动结构，by 后面是新事物；主动结构是 replace A with B。地图上描述设施更新用它，时态通常用过去时。

expressions.head: be converted into
expressions.meaning_zh: 被改造成；被改建为（用途变了，建筑还在）

examples.en: The old factory was converted into apartments, and the area is now much busier.
examples.zh: 旧工厂被改造成了公寓，这一带现在热闹多了。

expressions.contrast_zh: 强调用途或功能改变，建筑本身还在；be replaced by 指原物被新的东西取代；be demolished 是先拆掉再建，三者描述的是不同变化。

expressions.head: expand

examples.en: The company plans to expand its warehouse near the port.
examples.zh: 公司计划扩建港口附近的仓库。

expressions.contrast_zh: expand 指面积、规模或业务变大；extend 常指时间延长或线路加长；grow 更泛，强调自然增长，不一定是主动扩建。

expressions.head: be demolished
expressions.pattern: X was demolished to make way for Y

examples.en: The old stadium was demolished to make way for a new subway station.
examples.zh: 旧体育场被拆除，为新的地铁站腾出地方。

expressions.contrast_zh: 只用于建筑物被拆掉；be destroyed 语气更重，常指灾害或战争造成的破坏；be removed 只是移走，不一定拆毁。

expressions.head: remain unchanged
expressions.pattern: X remained unchanged / remain unchanged at + level

examples.en: The boundary of the district remained unchanged after the rezoning.
examples.zh: 重新规划之后，这个区的边界保持不变。

expressions.contrast_zh: 正式，地图题里描述没有变化的部分常用；stay the same 更口语；remain stable 多用于数值，形容位置时不如 remain unchanged 准确。
